purpose: Human labels and provenance for an offline Skyrim plugin schema explorer. Evidence supports a selected REFR/CELL/STAT pilot; it does not establish full interpretation or retail runtime behavior.

native_target.evidence_tier: static code review only; no VM/runtime observation

source_catalog.scope_limit: Source declarations only; not a qualified retail catalog or per-record applicability map. xEdit's Skyrim SE predicate also includes VR and Enderal SE.

workbench.receipt_scope: Receipts contain actual MCP tool output and input schemas, with no decompiled source bodies. Field-level static descriptions below point to the P0 evidence ledger.

schema_catalog.current_code_source: P0 worktree crates/converter/src/esm/exporter.rs create_tables DDL; executed in SQLite :memory: for schema introspection, not a populated world database.
schema_catalog.relationship_label_rule: Show declared SQLite keys separately from relationships inferred in exporter/load-order code; no inferred/code link is a declared foreign key.
schema_catalog.introspection_limit: DDL structure only; no record counts, plugin coverage, current Data-folder corpus, or live DB row contents were inspected.

projection_and_identity.raw_vs_typed: records.data stores serialized parsed subrecord tag/payload pairs; it is a recoverable projection, not original byte framing (for example XXXX/short-length framing is not preserved there). Show raw occurrence bytes, parsed subrecords, and typed projections as distinct evidence layers.

REFR: XESP parent FormID plus a current four-byte tail projection
CELL: XCLC signed X/Y from first eight bytes

projection_and_identity.source_occurrence_and_overrides: Current SQL records are keyed by resolved FormID and expose owner/local mapping through formid_map. Load-order code remaps full/light IDs and selects later winners; deleted winners remove effective records. This does not retain every source occurrence or its original ordinal. Keep source occurrence identity, plugin-local ID, resolved FormID, and winning occurrence separate; missing occurrence provenance must remain explicit.
projection_and_identity.important_distinction: CELL.flags comes from the record header; CELL/DATA is a separate subrecord and remains raw. REFR/header_flags contains record-type-specific bits; do not apply one universal flag dictionary.

field_labels.label: Initial and parent-gated enable state inputs
field_labels.shape: Header bit 0x800 declared Initially Disabled; XESP = parent FormID + one flag byte + three trailing bytes. Flag bits 0/1 are declared opposite-of-parent and Pop In.
field_labels.projection: Raw header flags, typed parent ID, current four-byte tail column
field_labels.uncertainty: F0002 is declaration-only and runtime chain semantics are unproven. F0010 reports bytes 5-7 nonzero in 7,652/36,268 retail-master XESP rows. Expose byte 4 as the known flag and preserve bytes 5-7 unresolved; the current enable_parent_flags u32 conflates the flag and tail.

field_labels.label: Cell subrecord flags
field_labels.projection: Not typed by cell helper; raw payload retained. cells.flags is record-header data.
field_labels.uncertainty: Native reader also has a short one-byte path; no evidence it occurs in target corpus. Never merge it with record-header flags.

field_labels.label: Cell grid coordinates and trailing field
field_labels.shape: Signed X/Y in first eight bytes; xEdit declares one-byte Land Flags plus three bytes, Mutagen a four-byte flags enum.
field_labels.projection: Signed X/Y typed; tail not typed
field_labels.units: Grid coordinates; no physical distance unit established
field_labels.uncertainty: Native path includes a 12-byte form and stores one byte; exact tail semantics and source disagreement remain unresolved.

field_labels.label: Interior cell lighting
field_labels.uncertainty: Optional tails/source agreement and downstream consumers remain unverified.

field_labels.label: Lighting template link
field_labels.shape: xEdit permits LGTM or null; Mutagen marks non-nullable
field_labels.uncertainty: Loader consumes it and clears an adjacent runtime member; link resolution and nullability are unresolved.

field_labels.label: Directional material and angle fields
field_labels.shape: 12-byte SSE form in xEdit/Mutagen; native loader branches at FormVersion 0x2C and may read four extended bytes
field_labels.projection: Raw subrecord in records.data; not a typed statics column
field_labels.uncertainty: xEdit and Mutagen defaults disagree (90 vs 30); no per-record FormVersion/length census exists. Keep source labels qualified and values unresolved.

field_labels.label: Alternate model texture sets
field_labels.shape: Model texture payload; xEdit/Mutagen field names
field_labels.uncertainty: Native loader passes payload to the model-texture handler; downstream behavior is unestablished.

field_labels.shape: xEdit labels Distant LOD; Mutagen has a model field
field_labels.uncertainty: No direct MNAM case in TESObjectSTAT::Load; this does not rule out another loader/consumer.
